title: Bad gateway and upstream alternatives
summary: A failing proxy route can reflect upstream transport, TLS, routing or an upstream response. HTTP 502 alone does not identify which mechanism occurred.
checks: Compare a separately allowlisted upstream contract from the proxy vantage.
limitations: An external upstream PASS does not establish proxy-namespace connectivity.
applicability: Nginx proxy module; live verified on 1.28
